# Loki (LogQL) (`source_type: loki`)

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-probe-refs.ts from packages/probe-config. Do not edit by hand. -->

Runs a LogQL metric query and reports the single number it returns. Log lines are never stored.

- Runs on: an Observer Agent (set the metric's `agent` to its name)
- Thresholds: required when the metric is created (all four fields)
- testProbe: supported

## Value and unit

- no unit: scalar result of the LogQL aggregation, as returned by the query; Observer does not rescale it

## source_config fields

| Field | Required | Type | Default | Limits |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `base_url` | yes | string |  | URL |
| `query` | yes | string |  | up to 8192 characters |
| `auth_mode` | no | enum | `"none"` | `none`, `bearer`, `basic` |
| `token_ref` | no | string |  | env var name on the agent host (UPPER_SNAKE_CASE) |
| `username` | no | string |  | up to 256 characters |
| `password_ref` | no | string |  | env var name on the agent host (UPPER_SNAKE_CASE) |
| `tenant_id` | no | string |  | up to 256 characters |
| `timeout_ms` | no | integer | `10000` | 100 to 60000 |

## Rules

- The query must be an aggregation such as `count_over_time`, `rate` or `sum(...)`, not a raw log stream.
- `auth_mode: bearer` needs `token_ref`; `auth_mode: basic` needs `username` and `password_ref`.
- `tenant_id` sets the Loki tenant for multi-tenant setups.

## Example

```yaml
source_type: loki
source_config: {"base_url":"http://loki.internal:3100","query":"sum(count_over_time({app=\"api\"} |= \"ERROR\" [5m]))"}
```
